page.overview:
Who is Falkner?

Falkner has blue eyes and blue hair, which covers his right eye. He wears wears a white sash, some indigo shorts and a pair of black wristbands with red outlines.

Falkner wears a light blue jacket with a white outline.

Falkner's appearance remains the same as it is in Gold and Silver.

He wears a white-outlined light blue jacket, which is decorated with four white buttons. Falkner has white socks and black shoes.
